snippet.title: Ancient_Shadows_Awakening_Trailer #dungeon #gaming #indiegame #gameplay #rpg #games #steam
snippet.description:
Ancient Shadows: Awakening – a handcrafted dark fantasy dungeon RPG created by solo developer Petr "Kajman" Najman.
Explore ancient halls, uncover secrets, fight horrifying creatures and survive the darkness itself.
Every corner hides danger… and every shadow has a story.

Features:

Full 3D first-person dungeon exploration

Real-time combat with melee and magic

Crafting, alchemy, traps, survival elements

Bestiary, map system, and skill upgrades

Handcrafted environments with deep atmosphere

Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3829010/Ancient_Shadows_Awakening/

Developed by: Petr "Kajman" Najman
Solo developer – coffee-powered creation
